0022600005.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Lakers host the Golden State Warriors. Los Angeles will be without Adou Thiero (knee), Cameron Carr (oblique strain) and Collin Sexton (calf), while Golden State is missing Brandin Podziemski (back soreness), Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Lakers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1. Their last meeting came on April 9, 2026 in San Francisco, a 119-103 Lakers win.
